CarRecipeV1.title: CarRecipeV1
CarRecipeV1.description: Closed project-owned pixel-car recipe. It contains no text, color, URL, path, file, markup, shader, executable instruction, or conversation content.

CommunityRacePageV1.title: CommunityRacePageV1
CommunityRacePageV1.description: Bounded response-only Community race page. It preserves the score contract fields and may add only the participant's current active enum-only CarRecipe, without private identifiers, proposal state, timestamps, raw usage, or daily detail.

CommunityScorePageV1.title: CommunityScorePageV1
CommunityScorePageV1.description: Bounded response-only Community score page with explicit self-reported trust metadata and no private identifiers, raw usage, daily detail, or exact timestamps.

CommunityScoreQueryV1.title: CommunityScoreQueryV1
CommunityScoreQueryV1.description: Closed value contract for one bounded public Community score season. A future URL parser must reject duplicate parameters before applying this schema.

seasonStart.description: Inclusive Monday season start from 1999-12-27 through 2099-12-28.

ConnectorCarProposalResultV1.title: ConnectorCarProposalResultV1
ConnectorCarProposalResultV1.description: Generic acknowledgement that one authenticated device proposal was stored for explicit browser review. It exposes no proposal or profile identifier.

ConnectorPairingPollResultV1.title: ConnectorPairingPollResultV1
ConnectorPairingPollResultV1.description: Generic pending response or the single activated source/device binding available to the polling connector.

ConnectorPairingPollV1.title: ConnectorPairingPollV1
ConnectorPairingPollV1.description: Closed polling request that presents one short-lived token and the exact pending-key possession signature.

ConnectorPairingStartResultV1.title: ConnectorPairingStartResultV1
ConnectorPairingStartResultV1.description: One-time short-lived pairing material returned only after a pending transaction is committed.

ConnectorPairingStartV1.title: ConnectorPairingStartV1
ConnectorPairingStartV1.description: Closed anonymous request that starts one short-lived connector pairing transaction without account, usage, or credential data.

ConnectorSyncResultV1.title: ConnectorSyncResultV1
ConnectorSyncResultV1.description: Non-sensitive acknowledgement for a validated connector synchronization. Internal anomaly reasons are intentionally absent.

ConnectorSyncV1.title: ConnectorSyncV1
ConnectorSyncV1.description: Bounded self-reported Community usage submitted by one source-bound device. Derived ranking and trust fields are server-owned and intentionally absent.

ProblemDetailsV1.title: ProblemDetailsV1
ProblemDetailsV1.description: Bounded public error response that carries a request ID and stable code without stack traces, SQL details, secrets, or internal hostnames.
